newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador announces $2 bln investment program.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador announces $2 bln investment program.

text.p: Ecuador's President Fabian Alarcon has announced a $2 billion program of 20 investment projects to trigger economic growth, most to be privately financed.
"We will back 20 big projects of national priority which will allow investment on a grand scale by local and foreign capital," Alarcon told local television late Sunday.
The biggest projects will involve the privatization of the state telephone company in September, and the expansion of a trans-Ecuadorean oil pipeline at a cost of $110-120 million.
Ecuador will also call a tender for the construction of new power stations and infrastructure including water supplies, highways and housing, Alarcon said.
Most of the financing for the new schemes will come from private capital, he said.
